prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: single transparent medieval RPG dialogue portrait for a 74 by 100 pixel target, a substantive new drawing.
Input images: Image 1 is the identity reference; use its recognisable face/hair/clothing, subject to the current character facts stated below. Images 2–5 are style-only references Mara, Iwo, Leiya, Tore, for large planar face construction, strong nose and cheekbone clusters, compact dark eyes, small dark sclera, hard-edged low-resolution pixel clusters. Do not copy their identity or expression.
Output: ONE isolated head and tiny collar portrait, close-up three-quarter view facing slightly viewer-left. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no checker pattern, no framing rectangle, no text. Vertically composed 74:100 aspect ratio. Make a cohesive low-resolution hand-placed-looking pixel painting, with broad flat clusters and at most 32 muted temporary colours. Absolutely no dithering, no skin pores, no soft gradients, no smooth vector cartoon, no anime eyes, no bright whites.
Framing: large face dominates, extremely short neck, narrow partial collar only; no torso, chest, hands or props. Preserve complete hair crown, lateral silhouette, ears visible in this view, and the ends of visible hair. Real transparent margin around every outer edge: aim for 3 logical pixels at top and sides and 2 at bottom. Do not crop even a single hair tuft. Draw hair as a few large coherent masses, not rows of parallel streaks. Structure the skin with a prominent solid nose, brow ledge, cheekbone and jaw planes, 4–6 skin tones rather than pixel noise. Eyes are small dark shapes beneath strong brows with minimal muted sclera and no white sparkles. No romantic glamorisation.
Subject/current card: Liqui / 莉葵 / TRADE-NPC-LIQUI, a woman in her mid-thirties, finite-stock travelling materials and cloth purchaser, the same person between two towns. Preserve the identity reference's chestnut-brown wavy hair swept to a low braid on viewer-right, loose curls near ear, mature elongated facial silhouette, warm evenly wind-weathered skin, olive/forest-green outer travelling jacket over muted ochre inner layer. Keep the low braid compact and complete beside the head/short collar, not a long torso composition. Expression: capable, attentive and shrewd, one brow slightly higher, narrow side-looking eyes, the faintest asymmetrical closed-mouth half-smile. A practical purchaser reading an offered item's quality, not a spy or seductive young heroine. Age about 35, adult cheekbones and subtle nasolabial plane but no heavy age wrinkles. No jewellery added. Two-layer jacket visible as small green and ochre collar shapes only. The left ring-finger injury and sample clip are outside portrait framing; no hand, bag, coins, trade outcome or multiple people.
